lines.speaker: d
lines.text: A seven hundred twenty nine foot freighter vanished from radar, ten minutes after one calm radio call.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: No May-day. Twenty nine men, gone.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Hours earlier, the captain reported both radars dead, and heavy seas over the deck.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The Navy found it five hundred thirty feet down in Lake Superior. Torn in two. The stern, upside down.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The Coast Guard blamed the hatch covers. Others blamed a shoal, or three rogue waves.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Nobody ever proved which. Or why that last call sounded so calm.
